claims.statement: Custom organization roles permit granular subsets of administrative settings without full organization/repository administration; audit-log viewing is an example permission, not a granted role. The org-custom-role-with-repo-permissions branch includes repository settings, with pinned applicability GHEC and GHES >=3.15; the other branch describes organization settings only. This is not a least-privilege attestation or effective access receipt.

The Role assignments view supports optional Users/Teams filters and removal through a recipient's NUMBER roles control followed by a confirmation Remove action. The fragment says delete a role, but its assignment-view context differs from the separate Delete role definition flow; this wording ambiguity remains unresolved, not silently interpreted as verified definition deletion. NUMBER is a placeholder, not a fixed count. No assignment or role was removed.
Role management is reached through Organization roles in the Access section. This identifies a definition-management view, not assigned recipients, permissions, or actual management authority.

The Role assignments view optionally filters users or teams; each recipient's NUMBER roles control opens their assignments. NUMBER is a placeholder, and viewing a filtered recipient does not prove complete inventory or effective permission coverage. The included filter fragment was inspected.

An optional requirement for explicit property values applies in the pinned feature to FPT, GHEC, and GHES >3.20. When enabled, authorized users/apps must supply values while setting properties, creating repositories, or transferring them. Existing repositories without explicit values still inherit defaults; this is not retroactive proof of explicit values everywhere, semantic validation of values, or actual enabled enforcement.

Copilot suggestions for repository custom-property definitions are labeled public preview. The pinned variables resolve Copilot and public preview; suggestions are not accepted schema definitions, validated classification, general availability, license entitlement, or operational authority.
